approachGroups._note: Round 21. Named sets of outside nodes that say where a through car comes from or is going, in words a resident uses. Gates are placed by the first rule that matches (street names and classes at the gate, whether trips can only enter or only leave, and the compass bearing in degrees clockwise from north from the study area's center to the gate). Other outside nodes take the group of the nearest surface gate (ASSUMPTION). `overrides` (node id to group id) fix gates the rules place wrongly. `sets` are named unions. The reserved id `study-area` stands for the nodes inside the study area.
